response.justification: The candidate is a strong senior individual contributor with deep, varied technical experience — including genuine developer-tooling work (test runners, assertion libraries, CI/CD infrastructure, device orchestration tools) — but the resume shows no formal people-management experience, which is a core requirement for this Level II manager role. There is no evidence of conducting one-on-ones, performance management, or leading organizational change, and mobile-platform experience is limited to a single early-career stint. He would be a better fit for a staff/senior IC role in engineering productivity than for this management position.
strengths: 18+ years of software development experience, well above the 8-year minimum
Authentic developer-tools background: test frameworks (Trial, Fluent-Asserts), CI/CD setup, GitLab administration, device orchestration tooling
Strong engineering-culture signals: TDD, code katas, workshops, teaching, and open-source leadership
concerns: No demonstrated people-management experience (required: 2+ years managing or leading a team)
No evidence of organizational change leadership, roadmap ownership, or performance management responsibilities
Mobile-platform experience is thin and dated (iOS/Apple TV work in 2015–2016)

key_factors.factor: Developer tools and testing infrastructure expertise
